name: appsec-workflow
description: Use an AI agent and static taint analysis to create repeatable vulnerability checks from one security review

interface.shortDescription: Create repeatable vulnerability checks with static taint analysis
interface.longDescription: Use an AI agent to review the application and record its security context in versioned taint rules and dependency models. OpenTaint uses static taint analysis to run these checks across the project and in later scans.
defaultPrompt: Use the appsec-agent skill to run a deep scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a normal scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a lite scan with dynamic confirmation
